title: Microbial Transcription Factor-Based Biosensors: Innovations from Design to Applications in Synthetic Biology.
authors: Song, Kyeongseok; Ji, Haekang; Lee, Jiwon; Yoon, Youngdae
one_liner_zh: 综述微生物转录因子生物传感器设计及应用，虽涉及TF与配体结合及Cello计算设计，但核心是代谢物响应与基因回路，非TF-DNA互作建模，AI/物理模拟方法仅展望提及。
abstract: Transcription factor-based biosensors (TFBs) are powerful tools in microbial biosensor applications, enabling dynamic control of metabolic pathways, real-time monitoring of intracellular metabolites, and high-throughput screening (HTS) for strain engineering. These systems use transcription factors (TFs) to convert metabolite concentrations into quantifiable outputs, enabling precise regulation of metabolic fluxes and biosynthetic efficiency in microbial cell factories. Recent advancements in TFB, including improved sensitivity, specificity, and dynamic range, have broadened their applications in synthetic biology and industrial biotechnology. Computational tools such as Cello have further revolutionized TFB design, enabling in silico optimization and construction of complex genetic circuits for integrating multiple signals and achieving precise gene regulation. This review explores innovations in TFB systems for microbial biosensors, their role in metabolic engineering and adaptive evolution, and their future integration with artificial intelligence and advanced screening technologies to overcome critical challenges in synthetic biology and industrial bioproduction.
abstract_zh: 基于转录因子的生物传感器（TFBs）是微生物生物传感器应用中的强大工具，能够实现代谢途径的动态控制、细胞内代谢物的实时监测以及用于菌株工程的高通量筛选（HTS）。这些系统利用转录因子（TFs）将代谢物浓度转化为可量化的输出信号，从而在微生物细胞工厂中实现对代谢通量和生物合成效率的精确调控。TFB领域的最新进展，包括灵敏度、特异性和动态范围的提升，已拓宽了其在合成生物学和工业生物技术中的应用。诸如Cello等计算工具进一步革新了TFB的设计，使得复杂基因回路的计算机模拟优化与构建成为可能，从而整合多种信号并实现精确的基因调控。本综述探讨了用于微生物生物传感器的TFB系统创新、其在代谢工程和适应性进化中的作用，以及其未来与人工智能和先进筛选技术的整合，以应对合成生物学和工业生物生产中的关键挑战。
